description: This file defines functions related to tensor contiguity and memory layout analysis, including symbolic and concrete computations for contiguousness, channels-last formats, and non-overlapping dense tensors within the c10 namespace.

methods.name: _compute_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if tensor sizes and strides indicate a contiguous memory layout for concrete values.

methods.name: _compute_contiguous_sym
methods.description: Returns a symbolic boolean expression indicating whether tensor sizes and strides are contiguous, without throwing data-dependent errors.

methods.name: _compute_channels_last_contiguous_2d
methods.description: Checks if 2D tensor sizes and strides follow channels-last contiguous format for concrete values.

methods.name: _compute_channels_last_contiguous_2d_sym
methods.description: Returns a symbolic boolean expression indicating channels-last 2D contiguity.

methods.name: _compute_channels_last_contiguous_3d
methods.description: Checks if 3D tensor sizes and strides follow channels-last contiguous format for concrete values.

methods.name: _compute_channels_last_contiguous_3d_sym
methods.description: Returns a symbolic boolean expression indicating channels-last 3D contiguity.

methods.name: _compute_non_overlapping_and_dense
methods.description: Checks if tensor sizes and strides represent a non-overlapping, dense tensor layout.
